examples.description: The state Apier had observed for a Norwegian company at the end of a date
The changes Apier observed for a company in a window

description: Company history from Apier's archive of Brønnøysund observations. Mode `as_of` with `date` returns the state Apier had observed at the end of that day: every tracked field with its status, source and licence. Mode `history` with `from` and `to` (at most 366 days) returns up to 1,000 changes observed in the window, or with `view` `diff` one field-by-field comparison. The archive starts 2026-07-30 and nothing earlier is back-filled; `coverage` says what is covered. A record of what the register showed, not what was in force, never a verdict. Errors: VALIDATION_FAILED, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; a credential without `read:brreg` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). No API key? Use Bearer apier_sandbox_test_<suffix> (a fresh suffix) to get fixtures; valid orgs are the 818, 99966 and 99977 series and 999000002 (see GET /api/v1/sandbox/fixtures). Cost: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per call, prepaid (prices: the get_pricing tool or GET /api/v1/pricing). Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/company-history
description_nb: Selskapshistorikk fra arkivet til Apier over observasjoner fra Brønnøysund. Modus `as_of` med `date` gir tilstanden Apier hadde observert ved slutten av dagen: hvert sporet felt med status, kilde og lisens. Modus `history` med `from` og `to` (høyst 366 dager) gir høyst 1000 endringer observert i perioden, eller med `view` `diff` én sammenligning felt for felt. Arkivet starter 2026-07-30, og ingenting tidligere fylles inn i ettertid; `coverage` viser hva som er dekket. Svaret viser hva registeret viste, ikke hva som gjaldt, og er aldri en konklusjon. Krever read:brreg. Kostnad: 50 øre (NOK 0.50) per kall, forhåndsbetalt (priser: verktøyet get_pricing eller GET /api/v1/pricing).

date.description: Only with mode `as_of`, and required there: a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), not after today in Europe/Oslo. A date before the archive start is answered with the facts `not_checked`.

from.description: Only with mode `history`, and required there: start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD), not after `to`.

mode.description: `as_of` returns the state Apier had observed at the end of `date`; `history` returns up to 1,000 changes Apier observed between `from` and `to` (`truncated` marks more) (or, with `view` `diff`, one field-by-field comparison of the two ends).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (Brønnøysund ID); MOD-11-checked up-front — a failing value is rejected as VALIDATION_FAILED, so correct the number rather than retrying it.

to.description: Only with mode `history`, and required there: end of the window (YYYY-MM-DD), not after today in Europe/Oslo and at most 366 days after `from`.

view.description: Only with mode `history`: `events` (default) lists the changes; `diff` compares the state at the end of `from` with the state at the end of `to`.

name: get_company_history

outputSchema.description: Apier envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The /as-of or /history response: observed facts with their source, licence and coverage window; never a verdict.

title: Company state on a date, or its observed changes
